note: LAB E29 「처음 쓰는 ㅈ」 나레이션 — 해설 소진 세기 1.0(LAB 장부 머리말 「목소리」 10-28), 영어 줄 + 한국어 낱말 한 줄(지읒). 원본(우리편) E5 「처음 쓰는 ㄹ」의 줄 자리를 따른다. 굽기: node tools/나레이션굽기.mjs docs/마케팅/LAB_처음쓰는ㅈ_20261107/음성/계획.json --굽기

lines.text: My first try at this letter...
lines.prev: A beginner opens a Korean handwriting notebook and picks up a pencil.
My first try at this letter... It came out looking like the English letter Z.
That's a Z. The second try is slow and careful: a line on top, then two legs.
Okay, that one's right. But the third one came out fast, and the top line bent down into the leg.
lines.next: Then my Korean friend left me this.

lines.text: Then my Korean friend left me this.
lines.prev: Wait, is that Japanese? I crossed it out. The next day, a sticky note was on my notebook.
Then my Korean friend left me this. Look at the first letter on the note, and look at the one I crossed out.
Same shape. So the one I crossed out was not Japanese at all.
It was right all along! A line on top with two legs, or a line that bends into the leg.
Two ways to write this Korean letter. The name is jieut.
Wait, is that Japanese? Okay, new page. I write it again, bigger and slower.
One more time... and it came out the same shape again. I scribble it out.

lines.prev: One more time... and it came out the same shape again, the one that looks like a Japanese letter. I scribble it out.
lines.next: Then my Korean friend wrote this.

lines.prev: Nope. Still Japanese. I scribbled it out. Later my Korean friend picked up a blue pen and wrote on my page.
